symbols.name: block base
symbols.meaning: The base $B=2^{4p}$ in which each coefficient of a packed integer is a block.

symbols.name: packed polynomial
symbols.meaning: A polynomial in $\mathbb Z[y]$ with coefficients of absolute value at most $2^p$, whose packed integer is $u(B)$.
symbols.quote: Let $u=\sum_{j=0}^{r-1}u_j y^j$ denote a polynomial in $\mathbb Z[y]$ with $|u_j|\le 2^p$

symbols.name: second packed polynomial
symbols.meaning: The second input polynomial in $\mathbb Z[y]$, with coefficients $v_t$ of absolute value at most $2^p$.
symbols.quote: let $v=\sum_{t=0}^{r-1}v_t y^t$ denote a second input polynomial with $|v_t|\le 2^p$

symbols.name: product polynomial
symbols.meaning: The ordinary product $h=uv$ in $\mathbb Z[y]$ whose coefficients are recovered from the packed product.
symbols.quote: Write $h=uv$, and $h_k$ for its coefficient of $y^k$, with $k$ running over $0,\dots,2r-2$.

symbols.name: product coefficient index
symbols.meaning: The exponent $k$ of a coefficient $h_k$ of the product polynomial, running over $0,\dots,2r-2$.
symbols.quote: Write $h=uv$, and $h_k$ for its coefficient of $y^k$, with $k$ running over $0,\dots,2r-2$.

symbols.name: coefficient position
symbols.meaning: The position of a coefficient $u_j$ of a packed polynomial, which is also its block exponent.
symbols.quote: Here $j$ and $t$ are coefficient positions; the sum may be negative.

symbols.name: second coefficient position
symbols.meaning: The position of a coefficient $v_t$ of the second input polynomial.
symbols.quote: Here $j$ and $t$ are coefficient positions; the sum may be negative.

symbols.name: carry
symbols.meaning: The carry $\gamma_j$ into block $j$ when packing, which is $0$ at $j=0$ and lies in $\{-1,0\}$.
symbols.quote: On tapes, a carry $\gamma_j$ and a block digit $d_j$ satisfy $\gamma_0=0$, $0\le d_j<B$, $d_j\equiv u_j+\gamma_j \pmod B$, and $\gamma_{j+1}=(u_j+\gamma_j-d_j)/B$.

symbols.name: block digit
symbols.meaning: The digit $d_j$ stored in block $j$ of a packed integer, with $0\le d_j<B$.
symbols.quote: On tapes, a carry $\gamma_j$ and a block digit $d_j$ satisfy $\gamma_0=0$, $0\le d_j<B$, $d_j\equiv u_j+\gamma_j \pmod B$, and $\gamma_{j+1}=(u_j+\gamma_j-d_j)/B$.

symbols.name: real part a
symbols.meaning: The real component $a\in\mathbb Z[y]$ of a record, whose coefficients are $2^p$ times the real parts of the record's coefficients.
symbols.quote: A record $f=2^{-p}(a+\sqrt{-1}\,b)$ has real and imaginary components $a,b\in\mathbb Z[y]$.

symbols.name: imaginary part b
symbols.meaning: The imaginary component $b\in\mathbb Z[y]$ of a record, whose coefficients are $2^p$ times the imaginary parts of the record's coefficients.
symbols.quote: A record $f=2^{-p}(a+\sqrt{-1}\,b)$ has real and imaginary components $a,b\in\mathbb Z[y]$.

symbols.name: first record
symbols.meaning: The first polynomial record, a polynomial of degree less than $r$ with complex fixed-point coefficients.
symbols.quote: A record $f=2^{-p}(a+\sqrt{-1}\,b)$ has real and imaginary components $a,b\in\mathbb Z[y]$.

symbols.name: real part c
symbols.meaning: The real component $c\in\mathbb Z[y]$ of the second record $g$.

symbols.name: imaginary part e
symbols.meaning: The imaginary component $e\in\mathbb Z[y]$ of the second record $g$.

relations.quote: Signed coefficient packing computes its integer products by the [Schönhage–Strassen to Harvey–van der Hoeven multiplication](ss-hh-background.md), an ordinary subroutine call that costs $O(n\log n)$.
